description: Per-role keyboard affordances, aligned with WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices (APG).

link.note: Space does NOT activate links. Space scrolls the page.

tabs.state: aria-selected on active tab; tabindex=-1 on inactive tabs

menu.escapeBehavior: close menu, restore focus to trigger

listbox.state: aria-selected on selected option, aria-activedescendant or roving tabindex

dialog.escapeBehavior: close dialog, restore focus to trigger
dialog.initialFocus: first focusable inside dialog (or dialog container if none)

skipLink.position: first focusable element on the page
skipLink.behavior: visible on focus, invisible otherwise; skips to <main> or primary content

landmarks.note: Screen-reader users navigate by landmark; keyboard users navigate by tab. Both need structured regions.

refusedPatterns: Positive tabindex values (tabindex="5") — breaks default keyboard order.
Click handlers on non-button elements without role=button + tabindex=0 + Enter/Space handling.
Dialogs without focus trap and restoration.
Menus that trap tab — menus should not trap; Escape closes and Tab advances past trigger.
